claim: Across 2000 adult specimens of one beetle species, head width and wing length are associated beyond what body length explains: the partial correlation between head width and wing length, controlling for body length, is at least 0.30.

data_keys.meaning: head width of each specimen, in mm
wing length of each specimen, in mm
body length of each specimen, in mm

claim: Across 25 populations of one beetle species, with 40 specimens measured in each, wing length rises with head width at a given body length: the mean over populations of the within-population multiple-regression coefficient of wing length on head width, with body length as the other predictor, is at least 0.30 (mm of wing length per mm of head width).

data_keys.meaning: head width of each specimen in each population, in mm
wing length of each specimen in each population, in mm
body length of each specimen in each population, in mm

claim: Among 60 mice, treated mice produce more peak twitch force than untreated mice of the same body mass: the difference between the group means of peak force, adjusted for body mass by analysis of covariance, is positive with a two-sided p-value below 0.05.

data_keys.meaning: peak twitch force of one hindlimb muscle of each mouse, in mN
body mass of each mouse, in g
True if the mouse received the treatment, False if it did not

claim: Among 3 groups of 25 rats each, mean resting oxygen uptake differs between the groups once body mass is accounted for: the analysis-of-covariance F test of the group effect on oxygen uptake, with body mass as the covariate, has a p-value below 0.05.

data_keys.meaning: resting oxygen uptake of each rat in each group, in mL O2 per min
body mass of each rat in each group, in g

claim: In 300 patients with a continuous disease severity score measured before and after treatment, improvement is larger in patients with a higher severity level: the Pearson correlation between each patient's change in score (follow-up minus baseline) and the mean of that patient's baseline and follow-up scores is at most -0.30.

data_keys.meaning: severity score of each patient at the baseline visit, higher is more severe
a second, independent reading of the severity score of each patient taken at the baseline visit
severity score of each patient at the follow-up visit after treatment

claim: In 400 adults with systolic blood pressure measured at five annual visits, those with a higher initial blood pressure have a lower yearly rate of change: the regression slope of an individual's underlying yearly rate of change in systolic blood pressure on the individual's underlying initial systolic blood pressure is at most -0.03 mmHg per year per mmHg.

data_keys.meaning: systolic blood pressure of each individual at each of five annual visits, with the visits in time order, in mmHg

claim: In 24 intrabony periodontal defects treated by guided tissue regeneration, the level of disease explains the amount of change: the mean of the baseline and follow-up pocket probing depth explains at least 15% of the variance in the change in pocket probing depth (follow-up minus baseline), that is, the R-squared of the linear regression of the change on that mean is at least 0.15.

data_keys.meaning: pocket probing depth of each defect at the baseline examination, in mm
a second, independent probing of the depth of each defect at the baseline examination, in mm
pocket probing depth of each defect at the follow-up examination after treatment, in mm

claim: Among 40 anaesthetised dogs, whole-body oxygen consumption and oxygen delivery, each computed from the measured cardiac output and the arterial and mixed-venous blood oxygen contents by the standard Fick definitions, are positively related: their Pearson correlation is at least 0.40.

data_keys.meaning: cardiac output of each dog, in L per min
a second, independent determination of the cardiac output of each dog, in L per min
arterial blood oxygen content of each dog, in mL O2 per dL
mixed-venous blood oxygen content of each dog, in mL O2 per dL

claim: In 12 anaesthetised dogs, each studied at 8 steps, whole-body oxygen consumption rises with oxygen delivery within a dog, both computed from the measured cardiac output and the arterial and mixed-venous blood oxygen contents by the standard Fick definitions: the mean over dogs of the within-dog regression slope of oxygen consumption on oxygen delivery is at least 0.15 (mL O2 per min per mL O2 per min).

data_keys.meaning: cardiac output of each dog at each step, in L per min
a second, independent determination of the cardiac output of each dog at each step, in L per min
arterial blood oxygen content of each dog at each step, in mL O2 per dL
mixed-venous blood oxygen content of each dog at each step, in mL O2 per dL

claim: Across 120 anaesthetised animals, tissues extract more oxygen when more is supplied: the Pearson correlation between the arterial-minus-mixed-venous oxygen content difference and the arterial oxygen content is at least 0.30.

data_keys.meaning: arterial blood oxygen content of each animal, in mL O2 per dL
a second, independent determination of the arterial blood oxygen content of each animal, in mL O2 per dL
mixed-venous blood oxygen content of each animal, in mL O2 per dL
a second, independent determination of the mixed-venous blood oxygen content of each animal, in mL O2 per dL

claim: Among 400 adult beetles measured on six skeletal dimensions, the dimensions share a common shape pattern beyond body length: after removing the linear effect of body length from each of the six dimensions, the first principal component of their covariance matrix explains at least 40% of the total variance.

data_keys.meaning: six linear skeletal dimensions of each specimen, in mm
body length of each specimen, in mm

claim: In 30 subjects each studied in a vehicle session and in a drug session, the drug raises muscle force: the mean paired difference in force between the drug and the vehicle session, adjusted for the muscle cross-sectional area measured in each session by analysis of covariance, is positive with a two-sided p-value below 0.05.

data_keys.meaning: peak voluntary knee-extension force of each subject in the vehicle session, in N
peak voluntary knee-extension force of each subject in the drug session, in N
quadriceps cross-sectional area of each subject measured in the vehicle session, in cm2
quadriceps cross-sectional area of each subject measured in the drug session, in cm2

claim: Among 150 adults with systolic blood pressure measured at three annual visits, those with a higher initial blood pressure have a lower yearly rate of change: the Pearson correlation between an individual's underlying yearly rate of change in systolic blood pressure and the individual's underlying initial systolic blood pressure is at most -0.30.

data_keys.meaning: systolic blood pressure of each individual at each of three annual visits, with the visits in time order, in mmHg

claim: Among 600 anaesthetised dogs, whole-body oxygen consumption, computed from the measured cardiac output and the arterial and mixed-venous blood oxygen contents by the standard Fick definition, depends on cardiac output: the R-squared of the linear regression of oxygen consumption on cardiac output is at least 0.25.

data_keys.meaning: cardiac output of each dog, in L per min
a second, independent determination of the cardiac output of each dog, in L per min
arterial blood oxygen content of each dog, in mL O2 per dL
mixed-venous blood oxygen content of each dog, in mL O2 per dL

claim: Across 12 trials of guided tissue regeneration with 20 defects each, deeper disease means larger gain: the mean over trials of the within-trial regression slope of the change in attachment loss (follow-up minus baseline) on the mean of the baseline and follow-up attachment loss is at most -0.20 (mm per mm).

data_keys.meaning: clinical attachment loss of each defect in each trial at the baseline examination, in mm
a second, independent measurement of the attachment loss of each defect at the baseline examination, in mm
clinical attachment loss of each defect at the follow-up examination after treatment, in mm
